item.title: NHAI accepts NHIT’s Rs 6,221 cr offer to monetise two highway assets
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 17: NHAI has accepted National Highways Infra Trust’s offer of Rs 6,220.90 crore for the asset monetisation of two highway sections of 310 kilometres. Asset monetisation has emerged as a strategic tool in NHAI’s efforts to unlock the value of existing assets and attract private sector investment. item.title: 24 Of 44 PSUs In J&K Loss-Making, Four Non-Functional: UT Govt To Assembly
item.description: Jammu, Feb 17: Out of the 44 public sector undertakings in Jammu and Kashmir, 24 are making losses and four are non-functional, the Union Territory government informed the Assembly on Tuesday. The government said it is examining ways to strengthen the sick PSUs and improve their operational and financial performance. item.title: Greenzo Energy, Lord’s Mark Industries sign MoU to develop clean power projects
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 17: Greenzo Energy has signed an agreement with Lord’s Mark Industries to jointly develop clean energy projects across Uttar Pradesh, including a 60 MW green hydrogen capacity. item.title: Oscar-winning filmmaker Frederick Wiseman dies, leaving legacy of American institutions
item.description: NEW YORK, Feb 17: Frederick Wiseman, the celebrated director of “Titicut Follies” and dozens of other documentaries whose in-depth, unadorned movies comprised a unique and revelatory history of American institutions, died at 96. item.title: Three police officials killed in attack in Pak’s NW
item.description: PESHAWAR, Feb 17: At least three militants and as many policemen were killed during a search operation in northwest Pakistan, police said. item.title: New MPs take oath in Bangladesh
item.description: DHAKA, Feb 17: The newly elected Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) lawmakers were sworn in on Tuesday, six days after the crucial general elections in the country. Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has bagged 209 out of 297 seats, while right-wing Jamaat-e-Islami secured 68 seats in the 13th Parliamentary elections.
